title: FRT G01-G30 runner completion report
description: A runner's signed report of what it actually executed for one claimed EXECUTE run. The control plane verifies the attestation against the RUNNER trust purpose before trusting any field. Recording a completion is never a certification: the run still requires a separate VERIFY with independently verified evidence, and certificateFragment.certification stays NOT_CERTIFIED.

runnerId.description: Must equal the identity that holds the run lease and the subject of the calling identity token.

exitStatus.description: FAILED moves the run to FAILED; it never blocks on its own, because a truthful failure report is a valid completion.

customerCodeExecuted.description: Set true only if the runner really executed customer code. An unverified attestation forces this back to false.

productionOperationExecuted.description: Set true only if the runner really performed a production operation. An unverified attestation forces this back to false.

artifacts.description: Content-addressed outputs. Duplicate names, a missing digest, an empty URI or a non-positive byte count all block the run.

evidence.description: Evidence the runner produced. Every entry must name the runner as executor and someone else as verifier; a runner may never verify its own evidence.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of this object with the signature property removed, verified under the RUNNER trust purpose.

synthetic.description: Synthetic evidence can never support a real gate; reporting true blocks the run.
